caption:
editing audio by reading it instead of staring at a waveform

#podcastediting #podcaster #audioediting #creatortools

slides.text:
I cut a 40-minute episode
without touching a waveform

Delete a sentence you don’t like

The audio goes with it

No timeline, no zooming in
on a blue squiggle

slides.heading: Read it, don’t scrub it
slides.body: Cast turns your recording into a transcript you edit like a document — and exports finished audio
